question: On historical empty-square entries (the desk's arm shape on IEX 1-minute lines), do entries whose name moved fewer than 8 spreads in the 21 minutes before the entry (IEX range in bp / full SIP quoted spread at the entry second, in bp) do worse after the spread than the other entries?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-29 ~19:35 ET in chat, after move_to_cost_live came back UNDERPOWERED (trustworthy data, MDE ~18 bp): 'Movement-to-cos - agreed to Historical-bar check, as the fast route'.
registered_at: 2026-10-29 ~19:45 ET, before any historical event is joined to a spread.
origin: Replay exploration 9/28-10/13 (slope_now_explore): move_to_cost < 8 about -12 bp vs about -3.5 bp above. move_to_cost_holdout (replay 10/14-10/27) UNDERPOWERED (MDE ~21); move_to_cost_live (live fills 9/11-9/25 + 10/14-10/29, 97.5% fill-matched) UNDERPOWERED (MDE ~18). slope_now_hist (10/28, all events, GROSS 10-min, no spread) showed narrow range 0.25-0.5% at about -0.3 bp gross: the cost side was never measured.
prior: For: cost is the spread, and a name that barely moves cannot pay it. Against: the population is the whole warehouse universe with a fixed hold, not the desk's names and exits; the RTH history found entry shapes ~0 gross.
events: pitch_open / slope_now_hist empty-square fires (fast %R 21/EMA 7, slow 112/EMA 3 on warehouse IEX 1-minute lines with the previous session as warm-up; onset only, 15-minute refractory per name), decision minutes 09:51..15:20 ET (so the 21-minute window is complete and the hold ends before 15:31), entry at the next minute (e = t + 1).
sessions: Warehouse sessions 2026-05-11..2026-09-25. 2026-09-28..2026-10-13 is excluded (the exploration window). Halves by date: A 05-11..07-29, B 07-30..09-25.
sample: To bound data requests: per session, at most 60 events drawn by seed sha256('MTCH'|day|symbol|t) order (lowest hashes first), from events whose SIP price at e is $10-$200. The draw uses no outcome or spread.

measure.range: % range (high / low - 1) of the 21 completed IEX bars [t-20, t] ending at the decision minute t (warehouse, raw). Fewer than 15 bars = missing.
measure.spread: Full SIP quoted spread (ask - bid) / mid, bp, of the last usable SIP quote (bid > 0, ask > bid, age <= 15 s) at or before the first second of minute e. None = missing. Fetched with the data-only key, retried 3x; an unresolved error counts against that event only; > 5% errors = VOID.
measure.net: gross = SIP 1-minute close of e + 9 / SIP 1-minute open of e - 1 (10-minute hold), in bp; net = gross - full spread at entry (the desk's standard: the full spread charged once).
measure.move_to_cost: range bp / spread bp; LOW < 8, REST >= 8; missing excluded (counted).

statistic: Per session with at least one LOW and one REST: d = mean net(LOW) - mean net(REST). Sessions equal-weighted, day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided 0.975, t at n-1 df.
power: Count stage first, counts and MDE only (no means): LOW n, sessions with both groups, MDE = (t_0.975(n-1) + t_0.80(n-1)) x median sd_session(d) over 200 seeded relabelings ('MTCH-MDE') / sqrt(n), for all sessions and for each half. UNDERPOWERED if MDE > 8 bp over all sessions, LOW < 200, or sessions with both < 40.
pass: HOLDS only if ALL: (1) mean d <= -5 bp with t <= -t_0.975(n-1) over all scored sessions; (2) LOW pooled mean net < 0; (3) d's point estimate < 0 in BOTH halves; (4) per session, removing LOW beats removing the same number of events at random (1,000 draws 'MTCH'), by widest spread, and by lowest range, each in >= 95% of draws (ties at the cut seed 'MTCH-TIE', 100 draws); session-equal means over LOW union REST; (5) the power gate passed.
fail: Powered and any of (1)-(4) missed: NOT SUPPORTED; 'refuted' only if the all-session upper one-sided 97.5% bound of d > 0.
if_holds: Association on the broad market only, never cited as an edge for the desk. With the desk-specific replay and live checks underpowered, a HOLDS earns the replay gate test (knob refusing arms with move_to_cost < 8 at the arm, order-time spread, matched random refusal, forward sessions, '2 bp + average >= 0'), pre-registered separately.
information_only: Bands [0,4), [4,8), [8,16), >=16 by half; LOW vs REST gross (to show how much of d is the spread itself); win rates.
Drop top 3 days and top 5 names.
no_retuning: No other cut-off, window, hold or sample size is scored.
data_budget: <= ~6,000 SIP quote requests (data-only key) plus SIP 1-minute bars for sampled names; after hours, one heavy Alpaca job at a time.
script: tools/studies/move_to_cost_hist.py (count -> score), reusing slope_now_hist / pitch_open (events, lines), move_to_cost_holdout (Data, statistics, controls), written after a result-skeptic READY.

amended.when: 2026-10-29 ~21:20 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 (FIX FIRST, 12 checks), operator 'Yes, apply them', before any historical event is joined to a spread or quote.
amended.R0_precedence: Where this block conflicts with an earlier key, this block governs.
amended.1_outcome: PRIMARY outcome is mid-to-mid gross: SIP quote mid at e:00 to SIP quote mid at (e+10):00 (last usable quote at or before each second, same usability rule as 'spread'). Primary d = mean gross_mid(LOW) - mean gross_mid(REST). Net (gross_mid - full spread at entry) and the old bar-based gross are SECONDARY, information only. Why: LOW is defined by a wide spread relative to range, so a net d is partly the spread subtracted twice, and a trade-print entry on a rising tick carries bid-ask bounce.
amended.2_pass: HOLDS only if ALL: (1) primary d <= -3 bp with t <= -t_0.975(n-1) over all scored sessions; (2) primary d point estimate < 0 in BOTH halves A and B; (3) removal controls on NET: compare the session-equal mean net of what remains (LOW union REST, all sessions); removing LOW must beat removing the same number at random in >= 95% of 1,000 draws ('MTCH'), and beat removing the same number with the widest entry spread and with the lowest range outright (ties at the cut broken by 'MTCH-TIE', the median of 100 draws); (4) primary d < 0 on the events with SIP spread <= 15 bp (the desk's live gate); (5) the power gate passed. The old pass (1) and (2) ('LOW pooled net < 0', near-automatic) are replaced.
amended.3_population: Draw from events whose raw price (SIP quote mid at t) is $20-$200 (the live floor is $20).
amended.4_price_timing: The price filter uses the SIP quote mid at the decision minute t, never a price at e.
amended.5_adjustment: Warehouse bars are SPLIT-adjusted (warehouse_fetch.py Adjustment.SPLIT), not raw; range and returns are ratios and unaffected; the price filter uses the raw SIP quote (4).
amended.6_fires: Fires are computed on 585..920 (pitch_open defaults) so the 15-minute refractory sees fires from 09:45; events are then kept for t >= 591 (09:51) .. 920. Events do NOT require the d/x controls slope_now_hist needs.
amended.7_missing: Missing spread or mid quotes are reported by range band; VOID if more than 10% of sampled events are missing overall.
amended.8_power: UNDERPOWERED if MDE (on the primary mid-to-mid d) > 3 bp (the pass bar) over all sessions, LOW < 200, or sessions with both groups < 40. Each half's MDE is reported.
amended.9_budget: data_budget raised to <= ~12,000 SIP quote requests (three quote reads per event: e:00, (e+10):00, t for the price filter, sharing fetches where one window covers them) plus SIP 1-minute bars; after hours, one heavy Alpaca job at a time.
amended.10_contamination: Disclosed: slope_now_hist (10/28) already looked at GROSS 10-minute returns by range band on 5/11-10/13, which includes these sessions (narrow range 0.25-0.5% ~ -0.3 bp gross). Only the spread join and the mid-to-mid outcome are unseen.
amended.11_if_holds: Unchanged: association on the broad market only; earns a separate replay-gate prereg, never an edge claim.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-29 ~21:35 ET, result-skeptic round 2 (FIX FIRST): A1-A4 applied verbatim; the power bar (Option 1 or 2) awaits the operator.
amended_2.A1_draw: Replaces amended 3_population and 4_price_timing. Per session, walk the events in sha256('MTCH'|day|symbol|t) order, lowest first. For each, fetch the SIP quote at e:00 (the decision instant: bar t has just completed). Keep the event if the mid is $20-$200, otherwise skip it and count the skip. Stop at 60 kept events or when the events run out. That same e:00 quote supplies the entry spread and the entry mid; the price filter uses no other price.
amended_2.A2_budget: Replaces amended 9_budget's per-event count: <= 2 quote reads per kept event (e:00 and (e+10):00) plus 1 per skipped event.
amended_2.A3_removal: Added to amended 2_pass (3): each removal takes exactly that session's LOW count from that session.
amended_2.A4_statistic: Primary d is computed per session, as before: session-equal, sessions with both groups, day-clustered t at n-1 df.
amended_2.count_stage: The count stage prints the realized LOW share and the MDE before any mean; if the MDE exceeds the pass bar, the study stops (UNDERPOWERED).
amended_2.power_bar: Option 1, operator 2026-10-29 in chat '5 bp, 60 per day': amended 2_pass (1) becomes primary d <= -5 bp with t <= -t_0.975(n-1); amended 8_power becomes UNDERPOWERED if all-session MDE > 5 bp (LOW >= 200 and sessions with both >= 40 unchanged); 60 kept events per session; ~12k quote reads.
